name: bws-better
description: /better <rough prompt>: asks up to three quick multiple-choice questions, rewrites the prompt with a clear goal, audience, format and finish line, and shows the original and the upgrade side by side. Nothing runs until you press Run. /better on turns typed prompts into upgrades automatically.

model.title: Upgrade model
model.description: Model alias or id that writes the questions and the rewrite (haiku, sonnet, opus, or a full id).
